title: Harbor & Pine Dental: booking site
stuck: A nice-looking site that nobody booked from. New patients still had to call during office hours.
now: One clear 'Book an appointment' button, online booking day and night, and every request lands straight in the clinic's calendar.

title: Automatic lead follow-up
stuck: Enquiries sat in an inbox for a day. By the time someone replied, the customer had booked elsewhere.
now: Every new lead gets a personal reply in under a minute and is saved to the customer list. The owner gets a one-line summary.
